observed.pacing: Frequent visual changes and short inserts, generally every 1-3 seconds.

captions.fontTreatment: Heavy sans-serif, white or yellow emphasis, dark outline/shadow
captions.placement: Centered lower third or centered over the visual
captions.branding: Small persistent upper-left label with a yellow accent

visuals.transitions: Hard cuts and simple wipes; no elaborate branded transition required

sound.musicAndEffects: Not added because no licensed supplied music or effects were provided

limitations: Reference videos were analyzed from representative frames; no protected branding or reference footage was reused.

The raw Gujarati speech was transcribed for timing, but the available small model produced unreliable Gujarati text. Existing burned-in source captions were preserved instead of generating potentially incorrect replacements.
No supplied B-roll, music, or sound effects were present.
